parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate of 'DebugMetricsProvider.updateMetrics' in that file is almost certainly a local debug convenience for the sample app's DebugHUD, not a production artefact. Merging it into the shared 'DebugPanel' package would couple production code to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is precisely the anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
